subject: Recap: discovery + clarifying who signs and budget ownership (next steps)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@atenza.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: discovery + clarifying who signs and budget ownership (next steps)

Hi Claire — thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying asks so we can draft a tight mutual action plan: 

What I heard:
- Primary use case: customer support triage and automated summary for Tier 1 agents (peak 2k reqs/day, P95 latency target 300ms).
- Success metric: 30% reduction in avg handle time and <2% false escalation rate.
- Data flows: chat transcripts will be sent to a private deployment behind their VPC; retention policy TBD.

Clarifying asks (can you confirm by Monday?):
1) Who is the economic buyer / budget owner for this project? Is that Marcus Li (VP of Ops) or someone on Finance?
2) Who owns security & procurement intake (legal contact + SSO/SAML owner) so we can scope the SOC2 artifacts?
3) Do you have an internal target date for POC sign-off and procurement (approx dates are fine)?

Next steps from our side:
- I will put together a 1-page POC scope + estimated cost for Dedicated/Private options and share an initial MAP by Tue.
- Laura (cc'd) can handle the security questionnaire and set up a short 30-min tech alignment with your SRE/procurement folks.

Attachments: I included a short one-pager template (attached) we typically use to scope POCs.

Best,
--
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
Attachment: redwood_poc_template_v1.pdf (PDF, 92KB)
From: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@atenza.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@atenza.io>, David Park <david.park@atenza.io>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: discovery + clarifying who signs and budget ownership (next steps)

Thanks Priyom — good summary. A few quick responses: 

1) Economic buyer / budget owner: Marcus Li (VP, Operations) will own the budget conversation. He is on CC here. Marcus partners with Finance for approvals.
2) Security & procurement: David Park (IT Security) will be primary for security artifacts; legal intake is handled by our procurement portal but David coordinates.
3) Timeline: we'd like a POC contract signed by end of Q4 (target 2026-11-30) with a 6-week POC after that. Procurement typically needs 3-4 weeks once scope is agreed.

I attached the RFP file we use internally (redacted). Marcus / David — happy to hand off any additional details to you if helpful.

Claire
Product Lead, Integrations | Atenza
claire.jensen@atenza.io | +1 (617) 555-3468
Attachment: atenza_rfp_2026.pdf (PDF, 320KB)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@atenza.io>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@atenza.io>, David Park <david.park@atenza.io>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Recap: discovery + clarifying who signs and budget ownership (next steps)

Laura — forwarding Claire's note. Marcus is the economic buyer; David owns security. Can you do the following please?

- Draft a 1-page mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones: scope sign-off, security intake, procurement timeline, POC start/end and acceptance criteria. Use the attached POC template and the RFP Claire shared.
- Prepare the standard SOC2 artifact bundle and our brief on VPC/private deployment options to send to David.
- Propose two slots (30m) for a triage call next week that include Marcus + David + Claire + our Solutions + Engineering partner. Aim for Wed 9/2 or Thu 9/3 in the morning (PDT).

I'll own the commercial estimate and put together the Dedicated vs Private cost table.

Thanks — can you confirm by EOD?

Best,
--
Priyom
